examples.summary: This is the general index page of the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook (MTQ-000), dated 26.10.2010. The document is organized into sheets (TAB) covering manufacturing standards for features like bearing seats, seal seats, threads, grooves, splines, and keyways, as well as component families including various shaft types, gears (planetary, ring, sun), and assembly/inspection guidelines. This index serves as the navigation structure for detailed engineering standards contained in subsequent pages.

examples.title: Table of Contents - Technical Quality Handbook Index
training_guidance: This index page lists the document structure of the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook (MTQ-001, dated 26.10.2010)
The handbook is organized into TAB/Sheet sections covering specific manufacturing and design standards for mechanical components
The Famiglia/Family section organizes content by component types (shafts, gears, planetary systems, etc.) with reference codes (e.g., 66300-A for Piston shafts)
An NX agent should reference the appropriate TAB or Family code when implementing standards for specific component types
Subsequent pages will contain detailed dimensional, tolerance, and manufacturing rules for each listed topic

The Famiglia/Family section indexes component families including various shaft types, gears (planetary, sun, ring), and assemblies with their corresponding reference codes.

training_guidance: This index page maps the handbook structure: MTQ documents are meta-documents; TAB documents contain specific engineering rules for component features
When generating shafts, consult TAB 004, TAB 005, TAB 006, TAB 008, TAB 009, and TAB 010 for bearing seats, seal seats, circlip grooves, and thread standards
For spline features, reference TAB 012 for involute spline representation standards
For keyway features, reference TAB 014
For gear components, reference TAB 007 (bearing groove connection) and TAB 011 (medium modulus execution)
For threading operations, reference TAB 002 (relieving groove), TAB 008 (ring nut threads), and TAB 017 (ISO triangular profile threads)

Component families 66300-series cover shaft variations; 66345-A and 66410-A cover planetary and ring gear components; 66420 and 66430 cover planetary gears; 66500 and 66555 cover planet carriers and nuts

When modeling shafts in NX, reference TAB 004 for seal seats, TAB 005 for bearing seats, TAB 008 for threads, and TAB 014 for keyways.

examples.summary: This page presents the table of contents for the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook, organized into TAB (Sheet) and Family (Component) indices. The TAB section lists manufacturing and design standards for components including shafts, bearings, seals, threads, splines, keyways, and gears. The Family section categorizes component types such as piston shafts, spline shafts, planetary gears, ring gears, and various shaft configurations, providing a structured reference system for mechanical design and quality control.
